message:
No other references to `formatRow` or `format.ts` remain anywhere in the repo.

**Deleted call:** `formatRow(e.name, e.amount)` — its definition (`src/format.ts`) is gone, so I removed the import and inlined the equivalent with builtin `String.padEnd`/`Number.toFixed`/`String.padStart`, matching the exact formatting the old helper used.

I also finished the body per its own pseudocode comment ("one line per expense, then a TOTAL line"): the previous code only produced the per-expense rows and never added the total. Added a `reduce` to sum amounts and pushed a `TOTAL` row formatted the same way, then removed the now-redundant comment.

No new functions/classes were introduced (`lock_definitions=y` default respected) and `renderReport`/`Expense` names are unchanged (`lock_names=y` default respected).
